scope: Only the Mods card panel and its search input routing; preserve the existing three-column cards, buttons and order.

layout.alignment: Centered over the three-column card area; existing scrollbar gutter retained.
layout.scrolling: Search row remains fixed; cards are clipped below it.

behavior: Live, case-insensitive module display-name substring matching with outer whitespace trimmed.
Clearing the search restores all existing cards in their original order; filtered cards cannot receive clicks.
Changed queries reset scrolling; UI scale changes preserve the search and its focus.
Focused text input consumes editing keys and prevents HUD selection/movement shortcuts.
Escape/Enter release search focus; clicking outside or closing the panel releases focus.
